name: jobtopgun-jobs-scraper
title: JobTopGun Scraper: Jobs in Thailand
description: Scrape Thai job ads from JobTopGun: title, company, province, job type, salary, posting date and, on request, the full description, qualifications, benefits and company data. Pay-per-result.
readme:
# JobTopGun Scraper Scrape jobs from JobTopGun ([jobtopgun.com](https://www.jobtopgun.com/)), the Thai job board. You get the title (Thai or English), company, province, work type, job type, the salary text with parsed THB numbers when the site gives them, the posting date, the employer highlights and the Dream Company badge for every job. Turn on the job page option to add the full responsibilities and qualifications (text and HTML), benefits, skills, education, experience, expiry date, workplace address with map position, the company description and the posting contact the company publishes. Search by keyword, province or region, job field, job type and experience, or give start addresses. ## What you get - One row per job, with salary numbers (from and up to, in THB) when the salary text has them, and ISO dates. - Optional job page details: full responsibilities and qualifications as HTML and text, job summary, benefits, skills, keyword tags, job fields, education, experience, valid-through date, workplace address, company website and description, anonymous employee review lines. - Each job once per run, even when several keywords or provinces find it. - A run with no input returns 5 jobs for the keyword engineer. ## Use with AI Agents (MCP) Connect this actor to any MCP-compatible AI client: Claude Desktop, Claude.ai, Cursor, VS Code, LangChain, LlamaIndex, or custom agents. **Apify MCP server URL:** `https://mcp.apify.com?tools=santamaria-automations/jobtopgun-jobs-scraper` **Example prompt once connected:** > "Use `jobtopgun-jobs-scraper` to find up to 5 jobs for the keyword "engineer" (engineer jobs in Thailand). Return results as a table with title, company, location and job URL." Clients that support dynamic tool discovery (Claude.ai, VS Code) receive the full input schema automatically. ## Input Every field is optional. Example: ```json { "includeDetails": false, "maxResults": 5, "maxResultsPerQuery": 5, "searchQueries": [ "engineer" ] } ``` | Field | What it does | |---|---| | `searchQueries` | Keywords such as engineer, accountant or sales manager. Each keyword is its own search. | | `locations` | Provinces and regions of the site: Bangkok, Nonthaburi, Pathum Thani, Samut Prakan, Chonburi, Rayong, Chiang Mai, Chiang Rai, Khon Kaen, Phuket, Hat Yai, Songkhla and 24 more, plus the regions Central, Eastern, Northern, Isan and Southern. | | `jobFields` | One of the 24 job fields of the site, for example IT & Technology, Engineering, Sales, Marketing, Human Resources. | | `jobTypes` | Full Time, Part Time, Contract (Contract/Temp), Freelance, Seasonal or Internship. | | `experience` | 0 (fresh graduates) or 3-5 (three to five years). These are the two experience pages the site links. | | `startUrls` | Addresses under https://www.jobtopgun.com/en/jobs, for example a filtered result page copied from the browser (its parameters are kept) or one job address. | | `maxResultsPerQuery` | Jobs per keyword, filter combination or start address. Default 50, up to 1000. | | `maxResults` | Jobs in total. Default 200, 0 means no limit. | | `includeDetails` | Read each job page for the extra fields. Default false, the price per job result is the same. | Each place, field, job type and experience value is its own search; the searches are combined with the keywords (at most 60 combinations per run). A value the site does not offer is skipped with a warning and gives 0 rows. Filters come from the links of the site: `/en/jobs/in-`, `/en/jobs/jobs-in-`, `/en/jobs/jobs-in-/in-`, `?jobType=`, `?experience=` and `?keyword=`. Combining a keyword with a place, a field, a job type or experience uses the same parameters on those pages; the site's own links do not show every combination, so check the result count in the log when you combine them. If the site does not apply the keyword on a page, the actor reads nothing for that search instead of delivering unfiltered jobs. ## Notes on the results - The site matches keywords loosely. A keyword without real hits still lists related jobs (the site shows a result count for it), and the actor delivers what the site lists. Set `maxResultsPerQuery` for keywords that may not match. - When nothing matches, the site shows its closest matches; the actor returns what the site shows. - Result pages hold 30 jobs. The actor stops at the end of the list, on a page with no new jobs, or at your limit. - The salary is mostly a phrase such as Negotiable or Depend on qualifications. Numbers are parsed only when the text has them. - The posting contact (`contact_name`, `contact_phone`) and the application e-mail and phone inside the company description are what the company itself publishes on the job page. Use them with the data protection rules that apply to you. They are only filled in detail mode. - Columns marked "Detail mode only" below are null (or an empty list) unless `includeDetails` is on. ## Sample output ```json { "id": "j125877-14", "title": "HR Analyst", "job_url": "https://www.jobtopgun.com/en/jobs/j125877-14", "company": "Southland Rubber Co., Ltd.", "company_id": "125877", "company_url": "https://www.jobtopgun.com/en/companies/southland-rubber-co-ltd-c125877", "company_logo": "https://static.jobtopgun.com/company_image/63/125877/logo_com_job/j125877.gif?time=20261111010150", "company_website": "https://www.southlandholding.com", "company_about_html": "

      ในบทบาท HR Analyst นี้ คุณจะได้มีส่วนสำคัญในการขับเคลื่อนการตัดสินใจด้านทรัพยากรบุคคลด้วยข้อมูลเชิงลึก คุณจะรับผิดชอบในการจัดการและดูแลความถูกต้องของฐานข้อมู...", "benefits": [ "Additional allowances and financial support", "Company-provided uniform", "Daily lunch allowance" ], "skills": [ "HR", "HR system", "HR analytics" ], "keyword_tags": [ "Hr Development", "Hr Planning", "Hr Policy" ], "job_fields": [ "Human Resources", "Compensation & Benefits" ], "industry": "Human Resources", "highlights": [ "มือโปร Power BI สร้าง HR Dashboard ให้ผู้บริหาร", "วิเคราะห์ต้นทุนแรงงาน วางแผนกำลังคนระดับองค์กร", "ร่วมขับเคลื่อน Digital Transformation HR" ], "badges": [], "dream_company_level": null, "review_snippet": null, "employee_reviews": [ { "role": "เจ้าหน้าที่คีย์ข้อมูล", "tenure": ">1 year, former", "text": "งานมีความท้าทาย", "score": 5 } ], "direct_apply": true, "is_urgent": false, "is_english_priority": false, "job_source": "JOBS_V1", "details_fetched": true, "search_query": "engineer", "source": "jobtopgun.com", "scraped_at": "2026-11-11T12:00:00Z" } ``` ## Fields | Field | Type | Description | |---|---|---| | `id` | string | Job address id j-, as in /en/jobs/. It is the dedup key. | | `title` | string | Job title as shown (Thai or English). | | `job_url` | string | Address of the job page on jobtopgun.com. | | `company` | string, null | Hiring company. | | `company_id` | string, null | Numeric company id of the site. | | `company_url` | string, null | Company page on jobtopgun.com. | | `company_logo` | string, null | Logo image address. | | `company_website` | string, null | Website the company gives on its profile. Detail mode only. | | `company_about_html` | string, null | About-the-company text with its markup. Detail mode only. | | `company_about_text` | string, null | About-the-company text. It often holds the application e-mail and phone the company publishes. Detail mode only. | | `company_banners` | array | Banner image addresses of the company profile. Detail mode only (empty list otherwise). | | `contact_name` | string, null | Contact person the company shows on the job page (as published, usually a first name and department). Detail mode only. | | `contact_phone` | string, null | Phone number the company shows on the job page. Detail mode only. | | `reviews_url` | string, null | Address of the company's employee reviews on yousayhrsay.com. Detail mode only. | | `hr_reviews_url` | string, null | Address of the company's HR reviews on yousayhrsay.com. Detail mode only. | | `location` | string, null | Provinces of the job joined by comma. | | `locations` | array | Provinces of the job as a list. | | `address` | string, null | Street address of the workplace as published (Thai). Detail mode only. | | `address_locality` | string, null | City or district of the workplace. Detail mode only. | | `address_region` | string, null | Province of the workplace. Detail mode only. | | `postal_code` | string, null | Postal code of the workplace. Detail mode only. | | `country` | string, null | Country of the workplace. Detail mode only. | | `latitude` | number, null | Latitude of the workplace on the company map. Detail mode only. | | `longitude` | number, null | Longitude of the workplace on the company map. Detail mode only. | | `work_type` | string, null | Onsite, Hybrid or Remote as shown by the site. | | `job_type` | string, null | Job type text as shown (Full Time, Part Time, Contract/Temp, ...). | | `job_types` | array | Job types as a list. | | `employment_type` | string, null | Employment type of the JobPosting data (FULL_TIME, ...). Detail mode only. | | `salary_text` | string, null | Salary exactly as the site shows it. Often a phrase such as Negotiable or Depend on qualifications. | | `salary_min` | number, null | Lower bound in THB, only when the text gives numbers. | | `salary_max` | number, null | Upper bound in THB, only when the text gives numbers. | | `salary_currency` | string, null | THB when the text names baht or THB. | | `salary_period` | string, null | month, day, hour or year when the text names it. | | `salary_commission` | boolean | True when the salary text says commission is paid on top. | | `experience_years` | string, null | Required experience as a range such as 1-5. Detail mode only. | | `months_experience` | integer, null | Minimum months of experience from the JobPosting data. Detail mode only. | | `education` | string, null | Minimum education level. Detail mode only. | | `posted_at` | string, null | Posting date, ISO 8601 (the site shows day/month/year). | | `valid_through` | string, null | Expiry date of the posting, ISO 8601. Detail mode only. | | `responsibilities_text` | string, null | Responsibilities as text. The list gives a plain text version; detail mode gives the full text with list marks. | | `responsibilities_html` | string, null | Responsibilities with markup. Detail mode only. | | `qualifications_text` | string, null | Qualifications as text. Detail mode only. | | `qualifications_html` | string, null | Qualifications with markup. Detail mode only. | | `job_summary_text` | string, null | Short summary the site shows above the description (often Thai). Detail mode only. | | `job_summary_html` | string, null | Job summary with markup. Detail mode only. | | `benefits` | array | Benefits (welfare) of the job. Detail mode only (empty list otherwise). | | `skills` | array | Recommended skills of the job. Detail mode only (empty list otherwise). | | `keyword_tags` | array | Keyword tags of the job. Detail mode only (empty list otherwise). | | `job_fields` | array | Job field and sub field names. Detail mode only (empty list otherwise). | | `industry` | string, null | Industry from the JobPosting data. Detail mode only. | | `highlights` | array | Highlight bullets the employer shows on the result card (often Thai). | | `badges` | array | Badges of the job on the result page, for example Better Chance. | | `dream_company_level` | integer, null | Number of hearts (1 to 3) of the Dream Company badge of the employer. | | `review_snippet` | string, null | One line summary of the employee reviews shown on the result card. | | `employee_reviews` | array | Anonymous employee reviews shown on the job page: role, tenure, text, score. Detail mode only (empty list otherwise). | | `direct_apply` | boolean, null | Whether the job can be applied for on the site. Detail mode only. | | `is_urgent` | boolean, null | Urgent hiring flag. Detail mode only. | | `is_english_priority` | boolean, null | English language priority flag. Detail mode only. | | `job_source` | string, null | Source code of the posting on the site. Detail mode only. | | `details_fetched` | boolean | True when the job page was read (includeDetails) and the detail columns are filled. | | `search_query` | string | The keyword search (or start address) that found the job; all jobs when none. | | `source` | string | Site host. | | `scraped_at` | string | UTC time of the scrape, ISO 8601. | ## Pricing Pay per event. The platform charges the event `apify-actor-start` once per run and this actor charges the event `job-result` for every job in the dataset. Price: $0.001 start fee per run, then $0.0012 per job result ($1.20 per 1,000 jobs). **New to Apify?** Every account gets a $5 free monthly platform credit, enough to try this actor at no cost. Jobs are charged as they are delivered. When you set a maximum charge for the run, the actor stops before it would pass that limit and says so in the run status. A job is never charged twice, also when a run is restarted. ## Related Actors - [Seek, JobStreet & JobsDB Scraper - Jobs Data of 8 Countries](https://apify.com/santamaria-automations/seek-scraper): Jobs from Seek, JobStreet and JobsDB, including Thailand. - [JobKorea Scraper](https://apify.com/santamaria-automations/jobkorea-kr-scraper): South Korean job listings from JobKorea. - [foundit.in Job Scraper: India, Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia](https://apify.com/santamaria-automations/foundit-in-scraper): Jobs from foundit in India and South East Asia. ## FAQ **Is the data in English or Thai?** Both. The site shows English labels (province names, job types, benefits) but most employers write titles and texts in Thai. Thai text is delivered as it is. **Why does a nonsense keyword still return jobs?** The site matches loosely and lists related jobs. The actor delivers what the site lists for the keyword. Use `maxResultsPerQuery` to keep such searches small. **What does includeDetails change?** It opens every job page and fills the columns marked Detail mode only. It takes longer, and the price per job result stays the same. **What if the site blocks a page?** The actor retries with a new session. If pages stay blocked, the run status says how many list pages could not be loaded, and the run ends with an error when nothing was delivered. ## Support Something broken, or a field you wish this Actor returned? Open a ticket on the Actor's [Issues tab](https://apify.com/santamaria-automations/jobtopgun-jobs-scraper/issues) or email contact@nanoscrape.com. We usually respond within one working day.
